G001.target_statement: Receive job updates for roles in the user's domain (e.g. software engineering, machine learning) that match the user's skill set
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原文直接陈述希望获得特定领域的职位角色，并希望职位更新基于自身技能集；主体、对象与范围均一致。

G002.target_statement: Receive a job update at the instant the job is posted on the platform while actively looking for a job
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原文以 'it would be great if I receive at the instant' 明确表达即时接收意愿，并绑定主动求职这一条件与发布时刻。

G003.target_statement: Receive job updates once a week when not actively looking for a job
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原文明确说非主动求职时每周一次 'is okay'，是可让步但明确选定的频率；未升级为必须。

G004.target_statement: Have the job list derived automatically from the profile (roles, work done, experience, skill sets, projects) so no additional filters need to be added
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原文明确表示期望资料中的角色、经验、技能、项目已设置好，提供职位列表时不需要再加筛选。

G005.target_statement: Customize a few keywords for the job search in the profile to get relevant results
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原文明确说自定义少量搜索关键词以获得相关结果，并在 T043 再次确认为在资料中自定义。

G006.target_statement: Receive only job postings relevant to the user's criteria, not a random or unrelated job list
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T071 将 'not having a relevant or updated job list' 列为不使用职位应用的理由，T055 明确抱怨不相关职位，均为明确的相关性要求；非仅凭抱怨推断。

G007.target_statement: Have the job list kept up to date so that postings one year or even 6 months old are not presented
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原文明确表达不会申请一年甚至半年前的职位，且太旧就不会继续申请；时间限定保留。

G008.target_statement: Be able to blacklist a job or mark it as uninterested so that it no longer comes back
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原文描述其屏蔽、移除、标记不感兴趣并希望不再出现的行为，属于明确的避免与结果意图。

G009.target_statement: Receive job updates by professional email
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原文 'I would generally prefer getting via emails' 与 'It'll be great if I get via professional emails' 明确表达渠道偏好，保留 generally 与 professional，不升级为强制。

G010.target_statement: Also receive job updates as mobile notifications provided they are not too complicated and do not fill up the mobile notification tab
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原文用 'unless' 明确给出接受移动端通知的例外条件，否定与条件完整保留。

G011.target_statement: Not miss important job opportunities because notifications were inaccurate or unrelated
G011.label: inferred
G011.rationale: 原文只陈述了因通知不准确、群发不相关职位而错过重要机会的负面经历；由该经历及 G006 的相关性要求正面推断其希望不再错过，未新增具体机制。
assumptions: 通知准确性提升可减少漏看
reasoning_steps: 确认原文有相关性诉求

G012.target_statement: Have the job notification email be very concise
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原文 'the email should be very concise' 明确表达简洁要求，强度为 should 而非 must。

G013.target_statement: Have all the necessary job details present in the notification email itself
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原文明确说邮件应含必要详情、'everything is in the email'、'All the details are present in the email'；详略与 G012 的张力记入 review_questions。

G014.target_statement: Apply to a job directly from where the update is received via a direct apply button in the email or a quick apply button in the portal, instead of navigating to the app and then the company's portal
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: T009 明确要求邮件内直接申请按钮以免跳转应用与公司门户；T099/T101 与 T100 明确门户网站需要 quick apply button，同一核心动作合并并保留两种载体。

G015.label: inferred
G015.rationale: 原文以'在想快速申请时，帖子方式没帮助'的形式表达，快速申请为隐含的期望结果而非直接陈述的系统要求；转写有断裂但语义可判定。
assumptions: 快速申请以直接申请入口为实现方式

G016.target_statement: View and apply through the company's job portal in an in-page (integrated) view inside the application instead of being navigated to another page
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: T067 确认页面内嵌视图 'would be really great to have integrated'，T059 明确抱怨被导航到另一页，主体与对象一致。

G017.target_statement: Have profile details already entered in the job portal transferred into the company's website/application form instead of filling them in again after uploading a resume
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: T067 明确希望职位门户资料自动转移到公司网站；T073 明确重复填写全部信息是障碍、耗时。

G018.target_statement: Be able to customize application details for a few specific job roles
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: T073 在让步句中明确表示有时希望针对少数职位角色自定义申请资料，保留 'sometimes'、'few' 与不要大量手工的约束。

G019.target_statement: Avoid getting jobs through a person's post that requires several rounds of messaging and waiting for a link
G019.label: inferred
G019.rationale: 原文明确评价该方式流程多、等待时间长、在想快速申请时没帮助；由此推断其希望避免该多轮往返方式，并保留 T017 的内推价值为相反证据。

G020.target_statement: Be able to connect with the person who posted the job to get a referral
G020.label: inferred
G020.rationale: 原文仅说明现有帖子方式在内推方面'helps me'，是对现有体验的正面评价；由此推断其希望保留该价值，未表达为新系统的明确要求。

G021.target_statement: Decide which job postings to apply for by weighing role interest and suitability, payment, location and company reputation
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: T019 明确列举四项排序因素并说 'considering all these factors' 才申请；同一动作的多项限定不机械拆分。

G022.target_statement: See reviews from current employees of the company
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: T021 明确说 'I would consider the reviews from the current employees'，是最重要的职位信息之一。

G023.target_statement: See what work the team is specifically working on and what stack they are using
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: T021 明确列出希望看到的工作内容与技术栈信息；原文转写为 'what text they are using'，按上下文理解为技术栈并在 context 记录该歧义。

G024.target_statement: See how the user would be contributing to the team or to the company
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: T021 明确说要了解自己将如何为团队或公司做贡献，属于独立的信息需求。

G025.target_statement: Have tech stack and similar details formatted as lists, cards or tables so they can be navigated quickly
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: T023 明确说用 list/cards/tables 格式化 'would be really helpful' 以便导航获取技术栈详情；保留原文 'list cars' 的转写形式于引文。

G026.target_statement: Have the job description and the responsibilities shown in separate UI sections instead of one long block
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: T065 明确提议用单独 UI 区分描述与职责，并说明长篇混排令人厌烦且耗时。

G027.target_statement: Have the necessary skill set explicitly defined in a job posting
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: T033 说明其查看职位时先看是否定义了必要技能集，T100/T101 确认门户需要的 criteria 包含 skill sets。

G028.target_statement: Have a tool or plugin that matches the required skill set against the user's and gives a match percentage
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: T033 明确说使用插件匹配技能集并给出百分比 'So with that, I'll consider'；T011 补充 Linkedin 的 50%/60% 百分比。

G029.target_statement: Use AI to identify and signal jobs that match the user's interest and skill set
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: T093 'Of course it will be great to actually identify jobs' 与 T097 确认明确认可 AI 用于识别职位；T035 说明 AI 会告知职位非常匹配，T091 说明算法匹配兴趣与技能集，T081 认可 AI 功能。

G030.target_statement: Not have AI write the application automatically; anything AI produces for writing should be verified by the user
G030.label: direct
G030.rationale: T093 明确认为 AI 代写申请不可靠，T095 明确 'it shouldn't be automatic' 且 'verified by us, then it's good'，T097 确认；否定与人工确认条件完整保留。

G031.target_statement: Have visa status, work eligibility and similar policy conditions taken into account when judging a job posting
G031.label: inferred
G031.rationale: 原文在回答'如何定义相关职位'时补充 'the other policies ... visa, status ... whether I'm eligible to work ... all comes up'；由该纳入考虑的表述推断其希望相关性判断涵盖这些条件，未假定由系统自动判定。
reasoning_steps: 推断而非升级为自动判定

G032.target_statement: Save or bookmark interesting job postings inside the job portal to apply to them later
G032.label: direct
G032.rationale: T075 描述其记录职位 id 并稍后跟踪的做法且不确定 Linkedin 是否有书签功能；T077 明确 'It'd be great to have such features in the job portal itself'。

G033.target_statement: Have every job-related activity available inside the job portal without navigating to another application or the company's portal
G033.label: direct
G033.rationale: T079 'Everything is present in the job portal'、T077 'I don't want to navigate to another application'、T061 'no point in having Linkedin ... navigate to other place' 反复明确表达集中完成的诉求。

G034.target_statement: See and track the status of submitted applications
G034.label: direct
G034.rationale: T105 明确 'I want to know what is my status' 且自评重要性为 10；T111 明确 'It would be great if I can track those status'。

G035.target_statement: Receive employer feedback on applications in order to improve later applications
G035.label: direct
G035.rationale: T105 明确 'if there is any feedback that would be really great for me to improve in my further applications'，T107 补充现状缺乏反馈。

G036.target_statement: Keep applications private so other people cannot see which job roles are being applied for
G036.label: direct
G036.rationale: T083 明确 'I don't want to Expose my applications'、'I don't want people to know for what job roles I'm applying for' 与 'everything private'。

G037.target_statement: Not have personal data exposed to people or platforms outside the job platform
G037.label: direct
G037.rationale: T085 明确 'I don't want my data to be exposed by other people apart from the platform'，主体与数据边界一致。

G038.target_statement: Not be contacted by random or irrelevant people or recruiters through the platform
G038.label: direct
G038.rationale: T069 将 'Random people reaching me out in Linkedin' 列为不使用应用的理由，T089 说明因资料不足被不相关职位的人联系。

G039.target_statement: Let the company's HR find the perfect candidate for a role through this feature
G039.label: direct
G039.rationale: T047 在回答'谁还能受益'时明确说明公司 HR 使用该功能以获得职位的完美候选人，主体为 HR 而非受访者。

G040.target_statement: Be able to enter more detailed profile information such as work experience and schooling
G040.label: direct
G040.rationale: T089 指出 handshake 无法填写更详细的工作经历与教育背景，T039 明确表示愿意提供已完成的工作，T087 指出自定义功能缺失。

G041.target_statement: Have configured profile details persist so they do not have to be entered again
G041.label: direct
G041.rationale: T081 明确说在 Linkedin 配置的资料会 persist 且 'I don't wanna again change those'，属于有继续维持意图的维持型目标。

G042.target_statement: Not be given a huge list of jobs that leaves the user confused about what to apply for
G042.label: direct
G042.rationale: T059 明确说大量职位列表会让其困惑、不知申请哪个，属于避免型结果意图。

G043.target_statement: Have job agencies benefit from these job update features
G043.label: insufficient
G043.rationale: T049 仅将招聘中介列为受益方，T051 为总结句，均未说明中介的具体需求、使用方式或期望结果；内容不足以判定一个可独立满足的目标，如实保留为 insufficient，不升级为 direct/inferred。
unsupported_parts: 具体受益方式与使用需求未表达
